summary: Create the active Session Contract from governed Design authority and, when applicable, a durable phase contract; require single-session safety evidence when delivery governance is not used.

triggers: a bounded session needs contract authority before implementation or review
a durable phase is adopted into the active session
single-session work needs affirmative safety evidence
single-session safety evidence must be recorded before skipping durable delivery governance

requires_artifacts: _hirmos/system/delivery/<delivery-id>/DELIVERY_PLAN.md when Delivery Shape Decision selects a durable delivery shape
_hirmos/system/delivery/<delivery-id>/phases/PHASE-xx.md when Delivery Shape Decision selects a durable delivery shape
